The Defective Detective - Album 3: Serah Contemplates

Station Thirty Three

"Station Thirty Three Where justice checks your category"

[Verse] Morning shift at Station Thirty Three Coffee burnt by half past three

Front desk blinking Phones on hold

Every problem color-coded

Gold walks in Someone stands

Silver gets a helping hand

Orange waits beneath the light

Until somebody says,

“Not tonight.”

Red gets told to try elsewhere

Purple barely gets a chair

No Category at the door

Doesn’t make the ledger anymore

[Pre-Chorus] Stamp it

File it

Turn away

Tell them jurisdiction ends today

Same old building

Same old plea

Welcome to Station Thirty Three

[Chorus] Station Thirty Three Where justice checks your category

Right color Right door

Wrong one You don’t matter anymore

Station Thirty Three Badge polished clean for all to see

Everybody knows the rules

Nobody says what they really mean

[Verse] Seeeka laughs behind the glass

Hakka drops another file in trash

Breena leans against the wall

“Resistance sympathizer. That’s all.”

Seventeen

Hitsujimimi

Orange beside her name

Meera sits beneath the lamp

Terrified

But holds her frame

“Tell us about the Rise.”

“I don’t know them.”

“South district.”

“I said I don’t know.”

Seeeka smiles

“That’s what they all say.”

[Pre-Chorus] Three Inujin

One locked room

Questions sharpened into proof

No evidence

No guarantee

Just another night at Thirty Three

[Chorus] Station Thirty Three Where guilt depends on category

Right color Right name

Wrong one enters already blamed

Station Thirty Three Procedure dressed as certainty

Everybody knows the rules

Nobody asks who wrote the scene

[Verse] Captain Pobo walks the floor

Old Inoshishi

Heavy door

“Report.”

Seeeka hands him half a page

“She’s connected.”

“How?”

“Association.”

“With whom?”

Hakka shrugs

“South.”

Pobo looks through observation glass

Meera’s trying not to cry

“Keep questioning.”

He says it flat

Then walks away

Before they see his eyes

[Bridge] Back office

Door closed

One drawer nobody knows

Under budgets

Under forms

Under years of compromise worn

A photograph

Edges bent

Two young officers

Before everything went wrong

Pobo

Half his age

Beside a Kitsune smiling wide

Sora

Partner

Friend

Long before his daughter lost them both

[Break] Pobo sits

Picture in hand

Station noise behind the wall

Phones

Footsteps

Someone shouting

Another denied call

He speaks so quietly

Even the room almost misses it

“I did the best I can, Sora.”

“I sent her away.”

[Pre-Chorus] Not because she couldn’t do the job

Not because she crossed the line

Because Station Thirty Three

Would have swallowed her in time

[Chorus] Station Thirty Three Where surviving means complicity

Play along Stay inside

Save the ones you can in quiet ways

Station Thirty Three Pobo wears authority

While every order that he signs

Takes another piece of what he used to be

[Verse] Night shift comes

Meera’s still there

Breena says,

“She knows something.”

Pobo reads the file again

Nothing

Nothing

Nothing

He marks a box

“Insufficient grounds.”

Seeeka frowns

“What?”

“Release her.”

Hakka starts,

“Captain…”

Pobo turns

Old eyes suddenly sharp

“Do you need me to repeat myself?”

Door unlocks

[Pre-Chorus] Meera runs

No one waves

Pobo watches through the rain

Then signs another useless form

And puts the mask back on again

[Chorus] Station Thirty Three Where justice bends selectively

Gold gets answers Orange waits

Red disappears between the gates

Station Thirty Three Corruption wearing policy

But somewhere in the rotten walls

One old boar is buying time quietly

[Final Chorus] Station Thirty Three The place that taught Serah how to leave

Seeeka Hakka Breena grin

The system rewards the ones who fit in

Station Thirty Three Pobo stays where she broke free

Not because he believes the station

Because somebody has to watch who doesn’t leave

Station Thirty Three

One photograph

One hidden name

One promise buried in a drawer

And one old captain

Still pretending

He believes what badges are for

[Outro] Lights shut down

Desks go dim

Pobo checks the hallway again

Opens the drawer

Looks at Sora

Then at the empty space beside him

[Spoken] [clean voice only]

“I did the best I can, Sora.”

“I sent her away.”

“And she still became a detective.”

A tired laugh.

“Of course she did.”
